title: Probiotic supplementation as a nutritional strategy for the prevention and management of sarcopenia in older adults.
authors: Wang, De'en; Yang, Wei; Qin, Xiaofang
journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨益生菌补充对老年人肌少症的预防与管理，虽含分子对接和机器学习，但核心对象为肠道菌群-肌肉轴，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Sarcopenia, defined as the loss of skeletal muscle mass, strength, and functional capacity over time, poses a significant health burden among older adults. A growing body of evidence indicates that the gut microbiota contributes to inflammation and metabolic regulation, mitochondrial function, and anabolic signaling, thereby shaping the gut-muscle axis. Probiotic supplementation has gained traction as a nutritional approach for the regulation of microbiome-derived metabolites. The present study aims to assess the rationale for probiotic supplementation to prevent and manage sarcopenia in older individuals. METHODS: Using data from NHANES (2011-2018; n = 3,500), UK Biobank (n = 5,000), and GMrepo (n = 800), we examined associations between probiotic exposure and muscle outcomes, inflammation, and microbiome diversity. C2C12 myotubes were used in vitro under probiotic-conditioned media (PCM). The interactions of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) with the regulatory proteins (mTOR, AMPK, NF-kappaB) were evaluated using molecular docking simulations. Random Forest and XGBoost models were used to predict sarcopenia risk using integrated multimodal features, with a 70% training and 30% validation split. RESULTS: Probiotic users exhibited greater handgrip strength (UK Biobank: 27.2 +/- 4.8 kg vs. 25.1 +/- 5.2 kg), higher fat-free mass (57.4 +/- 10.6 kg vs. 56.2 +/- 11.0 kg), and lower inflammatory burden compared to non-users. PCM increased fusion index (85.6 +/- 2.3% vs. 78.9 +/- 3.2%, p < 0.01), myotube diameter (45.2 +/- 6.3 mum vs. 40.1 +/- 5.7 mum, p < 0.05), and MyoD (2.1-fold), Myogenin (1.8-fold), and MyHC (2.2-fold). NF-kappaB and TNF-alpha were decreased (~0.60-fold and 0.65-fold, respectively), and PGC-1alpha was increased (1.9-fold). Butyrate docking revealed high binding affinity for AMPK (-6.9 kcal/mol), mTOR (-6.4 kcal/mol), and NF-kappaB (-6.0 kcal/mol). The performance metrics achieved highly in XGBoost with 88% accuracy. DISCUSSION: This comprehensive framework positions probiotics as a precision nutrition intervention for sarcopenia prevention, targeting muscle-sparing effects through microbiome modulation that stimulates coordinated immunometabolic and anabolic actions, with AI-enhanced, individualized risk prediction for healthy aging.
abstract_zh: 引言：肌少症（sarcopenia）被定义为随年龄增长而出现的骨骼肌质量、力量和功能能力下降，对老年人构成重大健康负担。越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物群（gut microbiota）参与炎症与代谢调节、线粒体功能及合成代谢信号传导，从而塑造肠-肌轴（gut-muscle axis）。益生菌补充（probiotic supplementation）作为一种营养干预手段，在调节微生物组衍生代谢产物方面受到关注。本研究旨在评估益生菌补充在预防和管理老年人肌少症中的合理性。方法：利用NHANES（2011-2018年；n = 3,500）、UK Biobank（n = 5,000）和GMrepo（n = 800）的数据，我们检验了益生菌暴露与肌肉结局、炎症及微生物组多样性之间的关联。体外实验中，使用益生菌条件培养基（probiotic-conditioned media, PCM）处理C2C12肌管。通过分子对接模拟（molecular docking simulations）评估短链脂肪酸（short-chain fatty acids, SCFAs）与调节蛋白（mTOR、AMPK、NF-kappaB）的相互作用。采用随机森林（Random Forest）和XGBoost模型，基于整合的多模态特征预测肌少症风险，数据按70%训练集和30%验证集划分。结果：益生菌使用者表现出更高的握力（UK Biobank：27.2 +/- 4.8 kg vs. 25.1 +/- 5.2 kg）、更高的去脂体重（57.4 +/- 10.6 kg vs. 56.2 +/- 11.0 kg）以及较低的炎症负担，相较于非使用者。PCM处理增加了融合指数（85.6 +/- 2.3% vs. 78.9 +/- 3.2%，p < 0.01）、肌管直径（45.2 +/- 6.3 μm vs. 40.1 +/- 5.7 μm，p < 0.05），以及MyoD（2.1倍）、Myogenin（1.8倍）和MyHC（2.2倍）的表达。NF-kappaB和TNF-alpha水平降低（分别约为0.60倍和0.65倍），而PGC-1alpha水平升高（1.9倍）。丁酸盐对接显示其对AMPK（-6.9 kcal/mol）、mTOR（-6.4 kcal/mol）和NF-kappaB（-6.0 kcal/mol）具有高结合亲和力。XGBoost模型性能指标表现优异，准确率达88%。讨论：这一综合框架将益生菌定位为肌少症预防的精准营养干预措施，通过微生物组调节刺激协调的免疫代谢和合成代谢作用，实现肌肉保护效应，并结合人工智能增强的个体化风险预测，促进健康老龄化。
